$comment: The single source of truth for how test/e2e/*.spec.ts is divided into CI suites.
scripts/ci/e2e-suites.mjs reads this file to resolve a suite to its specs, to decide
which suites a pull request needs, and to prove that every spec is owned by exactly one
suite. .github/workflows/05-e2e-smoke.yml and 06-e2e-full.yml read it through that
script, so adding a spec here is the only edit a new spec needs.
pr:true suites run on pull requests, Chromium only. pr:false suites are regression-only:
they are slower or engine-independent, and run in 06 E2E Browser Full Suite, which runs
every spec regardless of this partition.
projects names the Playwright projects a suite is meaningful on, which is what
scripts/ci/run-e2e-suite.mjs uses locally. accessibility.spec.ts is testMatched only by
the two axe projects, so asking for it on chromium would run nothing at all.
pathPatterns are JavaScript regular expressions matched against repository-relative
changed paths. A change matching sharedPathPatterns runs every pr:true suite instead,
because shared code cannot be attributed to one domain - and a missed regression costs
more than a suite that did not need to run.

suites.label: Auth
suites.owns: Sign-in, registration, password reset, session persistence across reloads, and credentialed CORS.

suites.label: Core User
suites.owns: The signed-in person's own surfaces: profile, the pages a brand-new empty account lands on, and the navigation architecture across phone, tablet and desktop widths.

suites.label: Jobs & Recruiting
suites.owns: The job board and its filters, and the recruiter journey against real postings, applicants and applications.

suites.label: Social & Workspace
suites.owns: Messaging access control and the workspace switcher: which workspaces an account holds, which one it enters, and what the switcher may and may not authorize.

suites.label: API Critical
suites.owns: The production bundle talking to the real API: one API base with no doubled /api/v1, no synthetic bearer identity in the shipped bundle, and an application receipt that survives a reload against real storage.

suites.label: Accessibility
suites.owns: The axe WCAG 2.1 AA scan of the core journey in dark and light mode, the posting page itself, and keyboard access. Engine-independent and slow, so it runs in the full regression on its own desktop and phone projects.

suites.label: Discovery & AI
suites.owns: What a crawler receives - server-rendered postings, JobPosting structured data, the sitemap and robots.txt - and the AI career assistant studio shell. Each seeds several accounts and postings per test, so they run in the full regression rather than on every pull request.
